card.name: Linking words in blood count lists
card.fires_on: Linking words or punctuation (including, and, comma) right after a blood count term or value, where the next item in the list is another blood cell measure such as platelets, hemoglobin or lymphocytes.

modes.label: including after CBC
modes.description: The word including follows a complete blood count and introduces its components.
modes.example: Obtain a CBC,<< including>> lymphocyte count, before initiating treatment with

modes.label: and after count threshold
modes.description: The word and follows an ANC threshold with its unit, before the platelet threshold.
modes.example: stop Dasatinib tablets until ANC ≥1.0 × 10 9 /L<< and>> platelets ≥20 × 1

modes.label: comma or unit after count
modes.description: A comma, unit letter or closing bracket follows a blood count value, before the next measure.
modes.example: absolute neutrophil count less than 1000 cells/mm 3<< ,>> or hemoglobin level less than 9

card.plain: It fires on the small joining word or mark that comes after a blood count and leads into the next blood count item.
